# Claude Watch

> An open-source, real-time observability dashboard for Claude Code. It reads what happens inside an AI-assisted coding session and renders it: the project's logic, what changed, and an AI-assisted search across session history. Runs entirely locally as a CLI (`claude-watch`) that starts a server and serves a web dashboard. Built in TypeScript with tsup for the server and Vite plus Tailwind for the front end. Session data never leaves the machine. Authored by Nir Diamant.

## Core Documents

- [README](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/blob/main/README.md): What it shows, installation and usage.
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository conventions for AI coding agents.
- [package.json](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/blob/main/package.json): Scripts, binary name and dependencies.

## Source

- [src/cli.ts](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/blob/main/src/cli.ts): CLI entry point.
- [src/server](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/tree/main/src/server): The local server that ingests and serves session data.
- [src/services](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/tree/main/src/services): Session parsing, indexing and search.
- [src/types.ts](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/blob/main/src/types.ts): Shared types. The contract between server and dashboard.
- [dashboard](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/tree/main/dashboard): The Vite, React and Tailwind front end.
- [bin/claude-watch.js](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/blob/main/bin/claude-watch.js): Published binary shim.
- [demo](https://github.com/NirDiamant/claude-watch/tree/main/demo): Sample session data for local development.
